[[Specialist/Legends|Specialist]] '''Rand''' was an individual who served as a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay controller within a docking facility in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Aldera/Legends|Aldera]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. In about [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] Rand after Rendar's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[LE-BO2D9/Legends|LE-BO2D9]] went missing, to ask the controller whether the droid had been taken away by port security.<ref name="Shadow Games">''[[Shadow Games]]''</ref>
